answer: Each submission hangs on the ripple of a task receipt, and the opal is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The pearl of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on proof-of-work sampling for lightweight verification. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a academic prose with citations to prior work register, it stays short.
